code_blocks.content:
Tiny Lane Defense

Pick a turret, click a glowing pad, start waves. Stop runners before they reach the gate.
Coins 90
Gate 12
Wave 0/6

15-second rules

Blue pads build towers. Bolt is cheap and fast. Frost slows groups. Enemies only use the center lane.

Status

Build on a pad, then start the first wave.

Click a blue pad to place your selected turret.
Keyboard shortcuts: 1 for Bolt, 2 for Frost, Space to start a wave.
